t:
This is where the threat to all of Sarnaut is concentrated? It looks... impressive.

I feel that Wigo is here. Let’s finish him once and for all.
h: How do you like the Citadel?

t: This place... increases my thirst. I feel madness approaching.
Hello, hero! I see you've managed to visit our celebration.

My current business requires my presence. Now that Wigo is done with, I may not fear a stab in the back. We still have to face the challenges thrown at us by the policies of the Great Houses. Can we deal with them? This is the question.
h: I see you've managed to leave Nihaz's Citadel for the Ball.

t: I'm afraid no one cares about such tiny details. No one will sort it out. The society regards me, Armando, and even Canaan the same. In their eyes, we're all smeared in blood. My House's destiny has a lot to do with the shard of the Seal of Darkness, the notorious Evil Mirror. House de Doucer is connected to Tep's powers that he obtained from another shard. The darkness is our shared destiny.
h: Was it reckless to connect your life with House de Doucer vampires? House de Tristesse wasn't involved in their crimes.

t: Why do I need you? That joke of a vampire, Wigo, will probably flee before I even make it to town... But fine, stay. You can entertain me on the road. Shall we go?
h: I was told to escort you to Amaranth...

t: That Wigo! We will surely encounter him. He's always got us into trouble. I hope I can persuade my kindred to leave him and come back.

Hello.

Who knew it would turn out like this? We vampires have joined Hirkalla's army - the forces that previously stormed the Citadel. The only thing that pleases me is that Wigo is dead, along with his minions.

I believe it's my duty to save the lives of those who follow me now. Jigran will be the gathering place for this new army. She wants to lead them against the gods of Light and Order should those invade our world.

Well, and the cure is just another promise.

Have you ever been to the capital of shadows, Dar Ulgorn on Jigran? We, vampires, have become the closest associates of the darkest empress, the backbone of her guard... Of course, things are uneasy there... Many are dissatisfied, because it is impossible to resurrect everyone at the same time. I have a feeling that a rebellion is brewing... And we will have to be at the forefront. Again.

I have always loved balls and festivals. Of course, House de Tristesse is not a Great House, but we still have pride in ourselves.

Since I represent House de Doucer now, I'm their equal.

quests: Problems of the City: Forest Lynxes
Good Deeds for the City: Owl Hunt

t:
Greetings from the House de Delice!

We're grateful to Catherina for giving us a chance to travel on her ship. It's very nice!

, we're grateful to Catherina for giving us a chance to travel on her ship. It's very nice!

Louis made the right decision when he sent the Galleon Castle to Umoir... Normally we have few opportunities to see the world outside our allods, so these few months have been rather educational.

And this celebration conveniently gathered all the important people here... We can hold talks that will begin the new era of peace in Sarnaut!

And of course, we all remember about you. This day is yours, so let's celebrate.

Hello, !

Oh, has it really been a year since our last conversation? Time flies... And I've been terribly busy... It's so difficult to rule the Elves!

One Great Game is over - now another has begun. The alliances have changed, and those who were our allies may become our enemies tomorrow.

Fortunately, I no longer need to prove anything to anyone. We, the House de Delice, always keep our word - the future of Sarnaut is diplomacy. I promised we'd make peace with the Empire, right? You got it.

I'd like to take part in this expedition of yours, but it seems that Catherina doesn't want us there. Oh, I'm afraid it will end badly for her - after all, our House, the House of born diplomats, could be very helpful in negotiations with the inhabitants of another world...

But no, the new toys are all they care about. The Ambrosia is such a strange thing. No, I do believe it's irreplaceable, but this resource should not be their priority.

Look at the guests. Did you notice how many moneybags are here? They all arrived to speak with Catherina and divide uncertain future profits. In exchange, they offer funding on an unprecedented scale. And some have already made investments. Several factories on Umoir and New Igsh have already started manufacturing combat Mechanoids. Combat Mechanoids!

I hope you'd be able to convey my concerns to Catherina.

They hear everything, youngling. Footsteps. Words. Thoughts.

Thousands of years have passed, and the sands still hear and remember the breath of every creature that has set foot into the desert. Yesterday, Nezeb walked here, today it's you, and tomorrow... who knows?

And the sands will always be here.
You will become a part of the Whole! There is nothing more important than fulfilling your predestination, finding harmony and accepting the Order!
h: Ask what happens if you agree

t: Nothing can stop the Great Design! Accept the Ascension!

Oh hello! Please take me to the central portal!  We must get there unnoticed. I will follow you, sneak when you sneak, speed up when you speed up. But if we are noticed, I’m going to return to this cage. It will remain open, but we will have to start all over again.

It’s so exciting, isn’t it?!
What?! I don’t give away no mana batteries. I’m calling the guards now...
What are you doing here?! Get out of here, now, you leeches!
Oh, you are all so stupid! Damn you, damn you! You are incapable of anything!

quests: Good Deeds for the City: Beasts in the Swamps

t: Is there anything that the power of Light cannot conquer? I often think about it.

A little patience, friend!

Soon I will cast my spells on you!

Good afternoon, comrade! The expedition leadership instructed me to provide auras to the most distinguished participants.

What are these auras? It's simple. These are special charms that experienced specialists like me can cast. They can help you and your allies who fight shoulder to shoulder with you.

However, since spells require preparation, we don't give them to every recruit! This honor must be earned first.

It's simple - the more achievements you unlock, the sooner you get the reward. After gaining a simpler aura, you take a step towards obtaining a stronger one.
Hey, that was you who kicked Hoof out of the city! Huh!

Well, you know... It all went smooth at first, we moved into the castle and kept all the locals under our thumb. We thought we'd live as tycoons - drink wine, play dominoes, watch cinemas! Yeah, right!

While Hoof was withering over his gold, that Prophet took control. He threatened and brainwashed everyone - he's good at that, you know. He threw us out of the castle. This is when it started... I've seen plenty of things in my life, but nothing like what they are doing to poor villagers. They chop them alive and glue with pieces of Architects... They make zombies out of people! They say, it's the way to the Ascension! A great honor for the mortals! Screw them!
h: Ask what the fight is about

t:
Debt? My debt? Ew, I thought it was long forgotten, but no way. He will first forget his mother’s name, and then the debts. And you! Shame on you, luring last coins from poor people!

I will have to sell my last shirt to pay it off! Woe! Here, take this to Jade, let him choke on it!
Sarn promised me unlimited power! Where is it? I surrendered my garrison, and what did I get in return?!

h: Do you have something for me?

t:
I don't know that.

Could you find out what happened with my family? Lua-Katley was my wife. We had two children, Tui-Yum and Lai-Kuwa.

I know that the Curse has been following the Junes around. I managed to hold it off by destroying the portal that the Curse created. Here's a fragment.

I don't quite understand what's going on in the world, but I think you can find the trail of the Curse. There should be a place out there that has a connection with the Curse... and the likes of it.
h: What happened with the Junes next?

t: Oh, naive people... Why do you do this dance?

I'm a June... or rather, I was it once. Our people fell under the rage of our Creator's Curse. We ran, but the Curse has been following us everywhere. I stayed to hold it off and let my family escape.

I just won some time. I hope it was enough for my family...

[The spirit is looking at you in surprise]

You're the spitting image! Well... What do you want from me, little non-Forestfolk?

They just enjoy worshipping.

Did they tell you about the reason of our war?

The lesser people were the reason why the evil gods appeared. Unwise, they worshipped elementals. Two elementals, to be exact. They offered bloody sacrifice. The more they prayed, the stronger the wicked creatures became. This is how the two monsters came to life, Ayateotle, the master of frost, and Sheytekutli, the master of fire. They caused too much pain...

This is past now. I feel that you've found a stash with my story... or followed the footsteps of someone who found it. It doesn't matter. Now you know everything.

The auction house is a place where you can sell your items to other citizens, as well as buy items from other citizens.
The process is very simple. If you want to sell something, simply put the item up for sale and fill out the auction period and the minimum bid. You can also set a buyout price if you choose. Afterwards, simply confirm your request and I'll start selling your item straight away.
However, my services aren't free. You're charged a small fee for advertising the item, as well as a percent of the winning bid.
I can also help you find items that other citizens are selling. You can search for the things you want by type, quality, level, price, or name.
If you decide to buy something, you can purchase it immediately at the buyout price or you can make a bid that's higher than the last one. Remember that any other citizen can outbid you while the auction is still going.
All of the money that you make from selling items, all of your unsold items, and all of the items from auctions that you win will be mailed directly to you. You can retrieve them at any mailbox or postal worker.

Auction lives off deposits and commission. Nobody wants to work for free, you know! For each item you put up for auction you pay some gold. For a 24 hour auction, deposit is 33% of the vendor's price. Deposit for a 12 hour auction is 15% of the item price, and a 60 hour auction costs 60% of the price. As other players may pay for your items twice the vendor's price, or even more, you'll benefit anyway! If the item is sold, you will receive your deposit back, but we will withhold our commission. And if nobody buys your item, well, don't take it amiss, but we will keep the deposit. Commission rate is 5% of the actual selling price of your auction.
Ah, the lost soul... , I believe?

Ah, the lost soul... , I believe? I heard you are ready to open the Gates leading to the outer darkness. And it made me wonder - do those who dwell in that darkness know about the Light?

If they don't, then our mission is to enlighten them. Grant them the miracle of Resurrection, healing, and protection.

But if our Gift is rejected, then let the punishment fall on them. Give them revenge for the neglect and disrespect.

Woe to those who call evil good and good evil, worship darkness as light and light as darkness, regard bitter as sweet and sweet as bitter!

quests: Anarchy Is the Mother of Order

t: You have chosen an interesting time to come to the island of a Thousand Wings... Put away your weapons; I’m not your enemy. Maybe I’m even your friend. Don’t judge me by my interest in dark magic... You never know how it might serve you! I am offering you a deal. If one of you agrees to step in my rune, I will do whatever you want me to. What do you say?

h: First tell me about this place, and then we’ll see.

t: Just as I get distracted by the Order business, the world is going to hell.

What? Any reason why you can't take a walk to a Teleport Keeper? Wow, you heroes are getting real lazy.

Oh well, since it's urgent, you'll have your teleport. Hold on to your pants.

quests: A Great Creation: So they created earth
A Great Creation: The final stage

t: We're often regarded as newbies in Sarnaut, but only by ignorant fools. Our magic appeared together with the first Astral demon, with the first wind that devour you dear allods! People accuse us of being close to demons, but they don't see that oil and water can't mix! Demons are food for us. They're our servants, our slaves...

We're often regarded as newbies in Sarnaut, but only by ignorant fools. Our magic appeared together with the first Astral demon, with the first wind that devour you dear allods! People accuse us of being close to demons, but they don't see that oil and water can't mix! Demons are food for us. They're our servants, our slaves...
Akkya failed! In front of everyone! Scar will be our new leader! We will feast on your bones! Your days are numbered!
I'm very weak. I need to lie down.
What do you want, you insolent creature?
You think you can threaten me? Ha! If I get mad, you will never get another sip of clear water again!
Gib-bulb-lings? I don't know who you're talking about. There were three wild animals trying to desecrate my waters, and they were banished mercilessly!
h: Ask who drove the gibberlings away from the spring

t: Anyone can drink my water - but I won't let anyone wash their dirty paws in it!
Whaaat? Are you out of your mind, you weird creature? Springs are my feet; mountain brooks are my arms; rain drops are my eyes! You say you are going to trap me? Go on, give it a try!
h: Threaten to trap the Spring Spirit in a bottle

t:
Ay-hya, spirits are not to be trifled with! The gibberling family is lucky to be alive.

Here, take these seeds. We should make the master of the spring happy, eysh!
h: Tell about the deal with the Spring Spirit

t:
Dirty beasts, you say?!

Listen closely. Take my Spring Stone. Take it to the dirty beasts. Lift it above your help and call on my power!

My children will come to your call and clean your stables. Now go! You bore me.
h: We have those dirty Pegasi in our stables and...

t: What do you want, you insolent creature?
FRESH PIES, HOT BUNS, SWEET TEA! Ugh, I'm tired from all the yelling.
Haha! Now the old rascal will get what he deserves!
h: Make a deal with the witch

t: Well, as you wish. I’m not going to be the one to bury your bodies.
I'm here on behalf of the House de Grandeur!

, I'm glad Catherina doesn't seem to be holding a grudge! Because it was the House de Grandeur that didn't support her back on Scarge...

Although back then we didn't think she'd succeed. She was too young and flighty... And Smaragd's lessons served to made her arrogant rather than truly powerful.

I never considered these toys to be anything worthy of note. Did they help the Junes? Of course not! But Tka-Rik's magical powers were strong enough to overcome the Curse.

Well, what happened is history, and you, like many other heroes, are a part of it. So congratulations on that.

r483390.s: Priestesse of the Church of Light

t:
Our arms are tough vines, and our bodies are covered in durable bark.

We will grant these powers to anyone who will help us defend our home!

What book? Never seen no books. Books are no good.

I only heard screams and saw a ghost. He is well scary, but seems to be able to talk. Go talk to him!
May luck be on your side, friend.

I can supply you with anything you might need to support your Order. The more you contribute to the common cause, the better goods are available for you.

Everything is free but limited in quantity. Make your choice wisely.
Eh... I'm too old for these councils. I'm feeling drowsy... I would love to take a nap in my lair right now, for some five moons!

You want an old bear to be your defender? Haha! You are funny, cub. It will be a shame if the tiger eats you. Alright, I will speak out in your favor. I may be old, but my word is worth a lot!

If you survive meeting Scar, come to me. The old bear can teach you some wisdom!
We have been watching the little Pridens... But we, the First, are responsible for the whole world... We must keep an eye on everything... And we'll start with Isa.

He promised to return the lands of the Fjord to us. Our clan must grow and rule the shores of the seas throughout Isa! Like a thousand years ago!

Why did you have to ruin everything?
h: What are you doing with Kharyskhan?

t:
So you're going to sniff around? How do I get rid of you?! Okay, I'll tell you everything, just go away...

There was once a tunnel here. The hermits used it to get to the mountains in the east. But two hundred years ago something happened in the mountains. An earthquake shook the mountains, causing an avalanche that killed many of my brothers.

And then the Gibberlings came and brought down the entrance to the cave.

We were fine with that, because the Zvergs that occupied the local caves disappeared afterwards, and we had more space. It is a pity that the Urun soon occupied them instead.
h: We're looking for traces of the hermit who lived here two hundred years ago.

t: Rrr! Foreigners in our lands! Why are you here?
Here. Careful, don’t spill the honey!
Do you have a real friend? Not just a friend, but someone who you can trust your life with? Listen, I will tell you about a rite that will bind you.

What is it, to be best friends with someone? We are the Peas Family, two brothers and a sister, but we're not siblings. Cai's family perished in an Astral shipwreck. Brumhilda's sisters were kidnapped by the demons. Frodi's been orphaned since his very birth. We wouldn't have survived if we hadn't stuck to each other! Now we're closer to one another than any of the blood relatives! You can't choose a sibling to your taste, but your best friends are your own choice, so these ties are as strong as they can be!

You better take this kind of friendship seriously, just as a marriage, though these are not connected. A husband and wife, or a teacher and pupil, or a master and student may become best friends. Any two close friends of at least level 15 can! You may have two best friends at the most, they are to precious to throw around.

This rite is ancient, but simple. First, you will have to buy a ritual honey Bowl of Friendship from me. The stronger you are, the stronger honey you need, the more expensive it is. Offer it to someone, who you want to be best friends with. If they accept, drip a few drops of your bloods in the bowl, take a gulp, and that's it: you're Best Friends!
h: What does it take to become Best Friends?

t: The ties are strong, but still they can be torn. You won't need any special ritual, just say the words: "You're not my Best Friend any more!" If your best friend betrays you and goes over to the Empire, you won't need any words at all: your friendship is over, you're enemies. Ew, I hate the sound of it!
h: How to stop being Best Friends?

t: There are a lot! Firstly, best friends can go down to Dungeons together, even if they significantly differ in levels. Secondly, they can give each other a hand in Astral quests. Thirdly, one may teleport to their best friend from farthermost edges of Sarnaut. And finally, best friends can lend each other most precious things: their mounts and astral ships. See, how deeply you should trust each other?

You don't know about Kurgan either? Wow, you're so ignorant! Kurgan the Crafty, a Shaman. He just sat there on Coldberg. Until one day he had a dream. A prothetic one! He understood that the destiny of all the Orcs laid in the desert.  That it's the only path to freedom. If they went into the wilderness, they would see a sign there.  And then Kurgan went to the Orcs' camps and told them about his dream.

But no one believed him. Then he came to Suslanger. There are a lot of Orc troops here. Well, at first no one here believed him either.  And then Fury followed him. And then many others.

And then there was a sign. The west blazed with a green glow!  Everyone understood then - there it was, the time of Orcish freedom had come. We have shed enough blood for humans, it's time for the Orcs to become masters of their destiny.

There was something else Kurgan prophesied. He said a Legendary Orc will come through the old portal after being reborn. And then the Orcs will no longer need Great Mages!
What, didn't expect to see me here? I'm not easy to catch, haha!

You don't know Shrinka? Wow!

Shrinka the Nimble. He was a general. He sat there at the human headquarters. But they offended Shrinka, passed him for a promotion. He held a grudge.

And then the whole mess started! The Orcs on their own! Then Shrinka tore off his shoulder straps and went into the desert with his men. So the Nimble clan stood with the Merciless.

Except Shrinka wanted to rule over everyone. He sees himself as the leader of the new Horde, he dislikes following a woman... Fury, that is. And then something came between them.

What... you still don't get it? You have a goblin brain or what? We... ugh... we want freedom! Like in the old times. Do you know that the Orcs used to rule the world? There was an Orc leader called Skulnar. He defeated the entire Kania. And Xadagan got so scared that it didn't come into existence until much later. There you have it.

Anyway, we'll kick everyone's asses. You know why? Because we are many, and we are mighty. And we have the Ambrosia. After you down some Ambrosia, you can punch through a metal door. So it's over for the Empire. And for the League. The Orcs will rule the world.

You don't know who I am? I'm Blabber the Merciless. I mean, I'm... whatchamacallit... The agitator. I explain to people who don't agree with us that they are wrong. I like talking, hah.

And if they disagree with me, I whack them on the head! It's very convincing.

You don't know who Fury is? Fury the Merciless Crazystorm's daughter! Her father is old now, but Fury is incredible. She's tough. And angry like an astral demon. She takes orders from no one. Her father wanted her to sit at home, nursing his grandchildren. She flipped and smacked him in the face. Then ran away from home.

Fury can rip anyone apart. She went to the river to draw water. And there was a crocodile. She grabbed him and tore him in half. You don't believe me? Everyone knows this story. Fury fought three hulks in the ring. Defeated them all! Because she's fast and agile. All warriors respect her! At first, no one believed Kurgan, thought it was some Shaman nonsense. But Fury took his side. That's how we were created - the Landfill Warriors!
What do you mean, won’t admit?!
h: The guard won’t admit a lab worker! That’s an outrage! I will report on that!

t: A rat can’t sneak by my guys!

The Punishers were once clans of warriors! Or shamans. It doesn't matter!

Our strength is in our faith. We believe in our heroes. It doesn't matter who they are. Anyway, our ancestors give us strength.

Now the Punishers are leading the following clans: the Nimble, the Unyielding, the Bloodthirsty, the Flaming, and the Righteous!
h: Which clans report to the Punishers?

t: Our strength is in our heroes. Both the dead and the living.

It's not that simple!

Someone thinks we should have our own heroes. Tensess, Nezeb, and Skrakan are all human heroes. The Pridens also believe in the light, and they don't need other people's heroes. Why should we?

But some of the Punishers, especially those close to Crazystorm, still believe in the Empire. It won't be easy to convince them otherwise.
h: What do the Punishers think about the rebellion?

t: Silly shaggy pirate! The Burning Claw power will punish all!
Hello there! You must be hot and tired, have some water.
It’s such a hot weather! Drink some!
Don’t make the old woman upset, drink!

Finally!

I've been wandering Umoir in search of this traitor for ages... You led him right to me, sister! There are no words of mortals to express my gratitude...

It's time for vengeance!
What do you want from Boa, cub?

Boa knew that you would come for his-s protection. Don't as-sk me how. Boa always has reas-sons. I will s-speak my word for you.

Come after the Council. You'll s-see.
There's plenty of wise vipers on Is-sa... I'll have s-someone to talk to... S-soon we, the Firs-st, will open a portal from Howlem to other lands-s.
Phew, smells like humans! What are you doing here, heroes?
Who are you to ask me of such things? Let’s see what kind of heroes you are. See those undead and toads on the waterside? Go and kill them all!
I can do that, but I have a rule: I can only carry the undead. But I can fix that for you in no time, haha!
Oh, I’m just an old man, have mercy! Alright, I’ll take you...
h: Take us, or you’ll regret it!

t: You again! You need to cross the swamp?
Oh, that’s a tough job for an old man! Alright, hop on the raft.
Already leaving? I hope you enjoyed your holiday. Come back soon!

Hi there, chief! Is there something wrong with the Maze? You don't like it, huh? Bring it down, you say? No problem! Just bring me {item}! Last time we used rendrock, and the Maze's small clippings are still falling from the sky!

Hi there, chief! Is there something wrong with the Maze? You don't like it, huh? Bring it down, you say? No problem! Just bring me 25,000 gold! Last time we used rendrock, and I nearly went broke compensating worker's injuries!
That's a deal! Now I can pay the professionals to do it. We'll start shortly.
h: Pay 25,000 gold to blow up the Maze

t: Hey! You want to demolish the Maze again? No way, not even with {item}. When we brought it down last time, we pierced the water layer. That was one-of-a-kind jet, I tell you! No explosions till we fix it!
Hey, chief! You want to demolish the Maze again? No way! When we brought it down last time, we pierced the water layer. That was one-of-a-kind jet, I tell you! No explosions till we fix it!

Hey! You want to demolish the Maze again? No way, not even with {item}. When we brought it down last time, we pierced the water layer. That was one-of-a-kind jet, I tell you! No explosions till we fix it!

Hey boss! What's the problem? You don't like your Maze? Okey dokey, we will raze it to the ground! We'll just need some {item}, you know, to fortify the frameworks and stuff.

Just make up your mind about the style!

t:
Hey boss! We can train your fighters to jump into fire in no time. But you should be a role model for them! Take your best mace, put on your best armor! Show them what real warriors look like! It's good for morale, too.

Here's what it takes to increase the rank.

quests: The Big Hunt: Primal Black Wolves
Creatures of the Forest: Primal Boars

t: Lots of food. Chief is happy!

Lots of food. Chief is happy!

 Fought Booka-Booka! Booka-Booka almost died. Recovered for a long time, hmm!

Four years! Only drank fire water – to travel to your camp.

But Booka-Booka is not angry at ! Booka-Booka is friends with ! Will share fire water and tasty milk! If  comes back, of course.
Ah, I thought he would wait a little... Alright, I'm an honorable man. I pay my debts. Now I'll have nothing to eat, but here... take my money and go!
h: They say you owe money to Ace... He asks you to pay it back!

t: I come from a noble but poor family... Oh, I wish I could marry a rich bride... That would improve my situation... But for now, I'm forced to earn money by playing cards!

Ah, that Herman! He pines for my cousin, but he's afraid to talk to her. Yes, he's poor, but so what... just propose to her and be done! But no, he'd rather suffer...

And you want to join our community, I see. I could put in a good word for you if you work off my debt to the owner of the local casino... Oh, don't worry, it's a couple of simple errands!

Well? Shall we play?
You again, my friendfriend! Ready to play? We have cards, chests, June roulette. Or perhaps the lottery?
I respect pioneers that train one skill a million times, not one million different skills. Well, a million times might be an overkill...
It's easy. I show you a move, you repeat it. Three times, to reinforce. Seven moves total. Once you're done, the workout is completed.
h: You want to know about the workout?

quests: There's a healthy mind in a healthy body

t:
What in the world!

You got me out of my Gipat, dragged me here for some reason... Why? What did you want?

There are fewer and fewer ghosts on Gipat, they scattered in all directions...

Should I move away from my native village too? A good master is always in demand, even if they are a ghost...

I don't know what Gort is upset about. He should have stayed on Jigran or Gipat, it's not like anyone forced him to go! And my trade is going well: we have a stone house now, so we'll reach a new level soon! In short, I'm not going anywhere, I'm fine where I am! I came here to rest, but when I return, I will continue my trade!
What do we have here - a party? Who's paying, I wonder? And what are we celebrating? Your heroics...? Oh, really...
If only I knew! Like I have already suggested, try talking to the nearest jinns... Do they even talk? They have mouths, I think...
h: How do I solve these riddles?!

t:
What do you think? They are the reason I'm here...

The local ruins belong to the Junes! They arrived here, met the jinns, and joined forces with them in the war against dragons... However, something happened then. The jinns and Junes quarreled. Jinns left the lands of people, and no one saw them for centuries until Nezeb found them. The inscriptions on the steles are in the jinn language, but they used June letters...

I can tell you what each of these inscriptions means if you promise to help me...
h: Yes, in a way... Do you know what's written on these steles?

t:
You see, I know about the artifact stored here.

But I'm a practical guy. I have no interest in these marvelous sticks from the past. And there's a local June guard who has been carrying out his duties for years... I'd give anything to study it! It's a unique technology!

But it's inactive, and inactive means useless.

I'm offering you a deal. You will activate it using my knowledge, you will take your artifact, and you will not touch the guard. We both benefit.
h: What do you need help with?

t: It's the worst possible place for digs, my mentor would've been furious... But as soon as I started digging, I found it... Oh! Are you interested in antiques, too?

Great, great... Now I know the unlocking procedure! There's so much we need to do...

Ah, right, thank you. You don't need to come here again...
I have translated this inscription as follows: "Who has seen much in the desert?" I have no idea, it's just sand here...
h: What does "Ka pashyati adhikam irine" mean?

t: It means this: "Who is searching among the sands?" Well, I am!
h: What does "Ka esi avantaram valuka" mean?

t: It's easy to translate: "Who knows many things?" Definitely not us...
h: What does "Ka jnani aho adhikamu" mean?

t: "Bhramarah" means "Scarab". The correct translation of "Anshuman" would be "the Sun". "Jantavah" means something like "Beasts". Well, I'm tired of translating in this heat...
Are you seeking my advice, bayazy? Well, don't be. You have a good head on your shoulders. Think. Decide. You have come a long way, and I can't interfere with your life. Do what you think is right.

Do you want to feel the taste of real Skirmishes? Battles, where not only rough force matters, but also thoughtful tactical planning?

Then you belong on Dominion, where the best guild raids battle for the Astral treasures! The more successful your guild is, the more Realgar it gets as the reward. And the more is your personal benefit!

Ah, if only I had some brains…

Buddy! Don't be afraid! I'm not going to take your brains!

But perhaps you can hear it? Dark voices are calling... These are all the maidens of darkness, crows, spiders and snakes... Those who lived far from human settlements... They are now trying to get into this world...

They have lived in the space between worlds since ancient times, moving through cracks...
Now they are approaching Sarnaut... Slowly but surely... They will be here soon...

I would not be just a nothin' my head all full of stuffin'

My heart all full of pain.

I would dance and be merry, life would be a ding-a-derry,

If I only had a brain!

Braaaains!
Ready for the flight! They told us to say that.
Maybe the stars are shining bright, but true friendship is even brighter!
So eager to go spinning in the centrifuge, but bailing out when it comes to flying into space...
All right – this day, the grand day for all of Sarnaut, has come!

Oh, I happened to return at a bad time... Sarnaut is in danger once again, and this time it's not a demon, but the Mistress of Darkness herself who has conquered our world...

And worst of all, my loyal comrades - Danas, Naira and Fergard - are now on the other side... Under the power of darkness...

quests: Catch the Winds of Luck Again

t:
I'm glad to see you!

We are all together now: the heroes of Umoir, Rud Glaen, and even Skrakan himself! We should remember the old times, especially since we're about to go on a campaign again!

I'm glad to see you!

We are all together now: the heroes of Umoir, Rud Glaen, and even Skrakan himself! We should remember the old times, especially since we're about to go on a campaign again!

After all, evil is not only on Jigran, it has also made a nest on my Forox. Aidenus had a student named Bogsha who became the Great Mage when Aidenus moved to the Kanian Archipelago...

Bogsha took on apprentices, and there was a black sheep among them. Tritogor deceived his teacher and lured him into the Misty Valley where Bogsha got lost. Tritogor then turned to the dark arts and began to perform terrible rituals. The residents fled, but most of them took refuge under the protection of Ivan the Ascetic, the governor of the allod and the head of the Church! Now he seeks help from heroes to deal with Tritogor's betrayal, rescue Bogsha and drive out all evil from Forox!
What are women and all the treasures of the world to an orc when he has a loyal friend - his riding rhino, hah.

Nezeb seeks a victory by trying to unite the peoples of Sarnaut. I admit, this makes sense, even though the ambitious trickster dreams of even greater power... However, I want to propose a grander plan.

Nezeb seeks a victory by trying to unite the peoples of Sarnaut. I admit, this makes sense, even though the ambitious trickster dreams of even greater power... However, I want to propose a grander plan. Since ancient times, I have studied the outer worlds, and I have achieved a lot on these paths. Even though I haven't been to the Star Path, I know someone there can oppose Tep. And the Light is only one of the forces. Even in Death, Tep is not the absolute master!

We should form our own alliances with these forces, since many residents of Sarnaut have already set off on journeys to other worlds.

I was thinking about the world of Enod, Sarn's original world where the first elves were tempered in the fight against such threats. I think we should take a trip to Enod and enlist their help.

How is it going? Is everything okay?

So on behalf of Zayan and the teachers of our university on Ammer, I solemnly present you with your honorary degree.

Anyway, every nation has its own philosophy. While the Xadaganians seek the meaning of life in serving the state, the elves see it in Pleasure. And the Thread that guides the Gibberlings? And the Pridens' Tya and Tyalla? Do you see what I'm getting at?

I think you're familiar with all that. So I will gladly issue this degree. You've earned it, there's no question about it!

NSHU is the National Sarnaut Heroic University which teaches the disciplines required to become a true hero.

Although, of course, you can probably start teaching there yourself. After all, you've been through so much and learned how things work in practice... Now you can tell anyone what you know about the world.

So let me just mark all the courses as completed for you.
Philosophy allows us to discuss abstract things, but without understanding them, we are blind.
Just as usual, someone's asking for my badge! Take it! I have spares just for times like these.
h: Ask the goblin for his badge

t: Hey! Do you want to listen to my drums?

These ones? Oh, they are here for a reason!

You see, we want to show the people that demons are not as scary as they imagine. Of course, they can cause a lot of trouble if you unleash them... But believe me, killing them is pretty easy.

But I digress. See those coins in each cage? If you're brave enough, you can try and get them! Watch out for your fingers, though! They say that no matter how hard you practice, it always takes at least ten attempts before you can get a coin.

Good luck!

Fame and respect, of course! And a dozen of bruises, too.

For winning over Glum, you will be rewarded with a Copper Anniversary Coin; for winning over Lanky, with a Silver one; for winning over Fang, with a Gold one!
h: What will I get for fighting in the ring?

t:
Oh, hello!

This is fun. Good ideas! And interesting contests!

We have our own entertainment here, if you're interested: fist fights. It's simple – it's you or them. And you can bet your coin on fighters.

There are also demons... anyway, there's a coin in each cage. If you're brave enough, you can try and get them! Watch out for your fingers, though! Haha.

Oh, hello!

This is fun. Good ideas! And interesting contests!

We didn't think we'd get invited. After the whole mess with Zakhar Krestov on Sogot... everyone is side-eyeing us. They think we're some kind of fanatics.

But in truth... Our chief Negus Baruti was furious when he heard about it. He says our reputation is ruined, and the whole Sarnaut knows it.

So we'll lie low for a while. We have our own entertainment here, if you're interested: fist fights. It's simple – it's you or them. And you can bet your coin on fighters.

There are also demons... anyway, there's a coin in each cage. If you're brave enough, you can try and get them! Watch out for your fingers, though! Haha.

These ones? Oh, they are here for a reason!

You see, we want to show the people that demons are not as scary as they imagine. Of course, they can cause a lot of trouble if you unleash them... But believe me, killing them is pretty easy.

See those coins in each cage? If you're brave enough, you can try and get them! Watch out for your fingers, though, haha! They say, no matter how hard you practice, it always takes at least ten attempts before you can get a coin.

Good luck!
This Demon isn't eager to kill anyone. It must be local.
My pet's name is Sickener! Cause he's sick of the likes of you!
h: We're back. It's time to pay.

t: Yes, I'm alive too. Life gives you countless opportunities, doesn't it? A new time is dawning in Sarnaut, the time of the Free Traders, not the old states! In this era, people like me can rise to heights that have not been achievable until now, don't you think? In any case, my island is reopened, and soon the Arena will once again cheer for its champions!
Perhaps the young hero was thinking about participating in hot fights in the Arena? I'm ready to provide such an opportunity!

Oh, sacred Ambrosia, the blood of the Great Trees, the essence of life itself that nourishes and sustains us. I'm harvesting it.  Maybe you noticed that there are rivers of it here?

The Ambrosia is a divine energy manifested in the form of sap. As far as I know, it appeared in your world, but believe me - we had nothing to do with this. I don't know how it got to Sarnaut.

You can't live without blood, and neither can we - our whole world is saturated with it, but its real source is the Great Trees, the true expression of our Creator's power. We get no more than we need, and if we take too much, then life itself will start to fade. Perhaps someday you will have to visit the dead forest. The forest whose Great Tree has already died, and where the Ambrosia has already stopped flowing... A terrible sight. In time, the forest will finally die, and a new one will grow in its place.

It's also important that the Great Trees are able to generate new Ambrosia to replace the one we have spent only in the presence of the All-Mother.
h: Hello, what do you do here?

t: Hello! How do you like our Tree?

quests: Making Friends with Grass and Trees

t:
Hey, get out of here! This is Capa's island! Capa is first! It's all mine, mine, mine!
Crafty clansmen steal a march on Capa, yes, yes. Ugh, scoundrels! Not to worry, Capa will kill them all, and the treasure will be mine, mine, mine!
Outsider, do you also want treasure? There is a lot of booty there. An entire expedition dug. The scientists were eager, but they were still fools! They opened the locked door, they let the ancient evil out, and - boom - there are nothing but restless spirits roaming the island. Nobody hinders Capa now, except clansmen.... and outsiders!
 But Capa is not greedy, no, no. Capa wants to have a.... what's it called... a bet with you! If you kill all the scoundrels and monsters faster than Capa, the treasure is yours. Capa is not a fool, Capa does not want to fight with strong outsiders. If Capa kills everyone quicker, then the treasure will be Capa's. And Capa will kill the outsiders, because the outsiders are weak!
So, outsider, will you make a bet with Capa?
You will find these traders at the stern. You should know Gerasim Rivin, he's also there.
You should find her by the control room where she's messing around with her bunch of demons.
h: Where can I find a Demonologist trainer?

t: She's the ordinary girl on my right by the stairs... To tell you the truth, she makes me shudder.
h: Where can I find a Scout trainer?

t: Look around... She's over there, at the front of the ship, the bloody crazy orc.
h: Where can I find a Bard trainer?

t: Oh, he did a good job growing a flower garden in my cargo hold! It doesn't smell like sailors' sweat and mana anymore, though I'm afraid some termites might make holes in the hull... You can find him in the cargo hold next to the treasury. Don't forget to pluck a flower!
h: Where can I find a Warden trainer?

t: That dead man! Oh, I'm sorry, it's not entirely politically correct... The Arisen removed me from piloting my own ship! The damned bookworm got to the steering wheel, and my ship flew, full steam ahead! Even she turned against me... You can find him in the control room.
h: Where can I find an Engineer trainer?

t: The damned mages must be thinking that this ship is their property! The Supreme Mage pulled off a pandemonium right on the balcony at the stern. You can't miss him if you head to the scanner hall.
h: Where can I find a Mage trainer?

t: Oh, he's my only sane passenger. He's sitting at his desk all the time scribbling something, so calm and quiet, just as I like. You can find him on the second deck by the stern.
h: Where can I find a Psionicist trainer?

t: Oh, another rot-stinking thing in my bilge... Can't you do without corpses? I've seen the injured taken to him, and not a single one ever returned... That's not what I call a healer! He's in the engine room.
h: Where can I find a Summoner trainer?

t: There was a duel! A duel on my ship! Go to the stern, stop at the open part of the deck, near the mannequins. They've been fighting in the open since dawn. You'll find them by the pools of blood.
h: Where can I find a Paladin trainer?

t: She's preaching to my crew. I often hear them say "What's the reason for living? Why aren't we serving the Light?" instead of "Yes, Captain! On my way, Captain!" She's on the main deck. You'll recognize her by a crowd of my sailors.
h: Where can I find a Healer trainer?

t: There was a duel! A duel on my ship! Go to the stern, stop at the open part of the deck, near the mannequins. They've been fighting in the open since dawn. You'll find them by the pools of blood.
h: Where can I find a Warrior trainer?

t:
Ah, there goes another one! I knew it was a fishy business! Take a side job, they said! Earn some dough, it's just a couple of heroes, take them to the edge of the Astral... Heroes, indeed. Writing on the walls, cursing all the time... Those Imperials now have a council in my engine room, they're handing out leaflets. What are you smiling at? Do you think, Kania is any better? There's a clerical tent on the main deck! They're deaf to duty and dead to shame! Do me a favor, stay in your cabin. I'll be very grateful. My ship's in a bad enough condition, I'm afraid it might not last long.

By the way, the Orcs have been drawing on the walls. Wipe them clean, will you?

Owing to the weakness of my health, I have exposed myself to spirituous beverages, certainly. But I am not to blame, but rather a friend; he led me into temptation, but was diplomatic and got away, while I...
You want to fool the savages? I'm sure that won't be hard to do.
Fine, I always have some spare clothes in my bag... Here, take it! Try not to tear it, it's natural silk!
Are you serious? A Priden in a dress - that's... original. But it won't fit even if you shed weight. You better ask Log, maybe he has something.
Oh, if something happens to the fruits... What am I going to do? How can I face the others?

Hello. She sent you to help me? Well, that's better than nothing...

I'm guarding the fruits while Chamomile is collecting and transporting them.

But Chamomile has been gone for a while! And her mount came back alone. I don't know what happened...

Please take her Corun and use it to bring the fruits to me. And look for Chamomile while you're at it!
h: Blackberry sent me. You need help?

t:
Hello. They sent you instead of Chamomile again? Well, that's better than nothing...

In case you don't remember what to do, I guard the place where the fruits are picked while you find new fruits and transport them here using a Corun. Come on, then. The fruits won't pick themselves!

quests: Gifts of Nature: Fruits of the Great Tree

t:
So you think we give a damn about your city...? Heh.

But you're in luck. The Unyielding got out of hand! Did you see the barricades on the way here? Now they are a threat to you and to us. It's that Shrinka... Damn him!

But don't get your hopes up. I will think about my guys first...
h: The Orc Raiders have lost all sense of reason, and our attacks just incited them. They are threatening to storm the city...

t:
You... What?

Although, if you think about it, everything is quite logical... Yes, and you would hardly dare to lie. You spend too much time worrying about the weak.

Okay, we have a chance to make my guys respect you a little...
h: Okay, there's more... I know who your reborn Legendary Orc is. Eladia and I can summon him.

t: Who are you? What do you want?
Greetings from the House de Vevre!

Ahem. , I should probably apologize for the situation with Elleken!

He was blackmailing me, you understand! He threatened to tell Claude's story... I couldn't let that happen! These ancient Great Mages are terrifying creatures...

Where is he now? He didn't deign to inform me. I believe he's trying to form an alliance with dragons. They are supposed to be mortal enemies, Great Mages and dragons... But Elleken has always admired them. I'm sure they can come to an understanding... After all, they have a shared goal now!

I hope you're not holding this against me on a day like this.

Maelle Alder is a stone proof that our people once relied both on magic and weapons like sword and bow. They say she could take out trolls with one strike... I wonder if she has any memory of the Battle for Beauty?

It would be interesting to pit her against this... Thalos? The one the Aoidoi created. It would be a sight for sure. Perhaps we could arrange a competition? If only we had a few functional June golems...
Greetings, . You have come to the Great House de Grandeur. My name is Albert de Grandeur. I’m the the second Head of this House and the Great Mage of the Lightwood allod!

Welcome to the celebration!

Well, I hope everyone can see I'm a generous ruler?

Letting you all board my Eclipse! I still can't believe I agreed to this... It will take months to clean it afterwards. I'll make undiligent students swab the decks as punishment.

But oh well. Have fun! Celebrate! We arranged all this for you. I'm serious.

Welcome to the celebration, !

Everyone loved it the last time, so we decided to do it again. Well, I hope everyone can see I'm a generous ruler?

Letting you all board my Eclipse! I still can't believe I agreed to this... It will take months to clean it afterwards. I'll make undiligent students swab the decks as punishment.

But oh well. Have fun! Celebrate! We arranged all this for you. I'm serious.

Welcome to the celebration, !

I'm sure you have a lot of questions about our project "Gates-3". Well, let me answer them: firstly, we are almost ready to activate it. We still need to take care of some things, and one of them is this cursed Chronophone. It's time to finish this story, but from what I gathered listening to Eladia's confused explanations, she wants Nihaz to take the first step. Personally, I believe someone is just playing for time.

Secondly, I will not invite you to join our Expedition. Why? There are way too many predictions relating to you personally. And I don't want some mysterious nonsense to interfere with my plans. I'm not taking demons with me for the same reason. No arks will sail outside Sarnaut. The best way to combat a prophecy is not to follow it.

You again, on my ship!

Well, I'm not going to throw you out, and I'm not in charge, anyway. Hirkalla is in command right now, and I have to obey her for the time being.

But I'm not going to sit still! I’m sure we can find a way to oppose her. If she thinks she can just come into our world and impose her rules, she's wrong!

Of course, I'm not going to fight her directly - that would be stupid. But rest assured, I'll find a way to put her in her place!

Well, I was wrong about Hirkalla... She is rather wise and unprejudiced unlike those retrogrades, Aidenus and Yasker...

Of course, she loves power... And I understand that. If she wants to be called the Darkest Mistress - so be it. Mistress of Umoir and Queen of Sarnaut will find common ground.

She has ambitious plans... Resurrecting everyone who has ever died? Why not? Restoring Sarnaut? I'm all for it. Hirkalla gave my Expedition access to other worlds. My students are traveling them right now, acquiring new knowledge and technology... The world... will soon change irrevocably.

At least this time I'm free from the gaze of the almighty goddesses! Well, hello!

I'm glad to see you aboard the Eclipse again. Relax, have fun, because now is that short time in the year when the last disaster has faded, and the next one is still looming somewhere on the horizon...

We have gathered here for the fifth time, and there have been fifteen anniversaries in your honor in total, if I remember correctly.

Not long before the current festivities, the Conclave of Great Mages was held here. They discussed the current affairs - Hirkalla, Tep, and everything else. The goddess sisters went to gather their strength after that, while we decided to think about something else.

The future created by Nihaz... how realistic is it? Is there some threat that could lead to the destruction of the world in the future? Nihaz did not invent this possible future - the probability of its creation was artificially increased... We know for sure that in this future Tep was defeated, so... Perhaps it's where we could find the means to fight him. Perhaps Cosmos could help us get there again and find what we need. Think about it!

Welcome to the celebration!

Well, I hope everyone can see I'm a generous ruler?

Letting you all board my Eclipse! I still can't believe I agreed to this... It will take months to clean it afterwards. I'll make undiligent students swab the decks as punishment.

But oh well. Have fun! Celebrate! We arranged all this for you. I'm serious.
If you're wondering what to do, speak with Anton Turischev. He'll tell you about activities on the deck.
Ah, there you are. Don't worry, not all of the undead have passed away of old age.
I've been waiting for this so long...

So these motley clowns are my reinforcements? I expected someone more... Anyway, to hell with the expectations. I must work with what I have.

Long story short. There's a demon under this Mound, and I'm planning to subdue it. You have a chance to eye-witness my triumph.

Any questions?

h: We're going to help you. What do we have to do?

t: Did you expect me to go all the way through the catacombs with you? I'll see you at the exit.

Urgent progress. Accelerated production. Creative genius and assiduous work.

This is all we need. As soon as you find out how one can arrange that, please let me know. One thing I can say for sure - Umoir soon is going to go through an industrial revolution. There’s no room for rustic superstitions when there’s a war coming.
h: What do you think about the war with Nihaz?

t: My advice is: less counsels and meetings, more action.
I’m very busy. What is the matter?

Aoidoi know that faith multiplies strength and that it’s the first step to divinity. By the way, come to think of it, we should be worried. The whole world will soon know about this.

Disturbances will arise.
I’m very busy. What is the matter?

If we don’t want to be playthings of a wayward god, we must become his equals. To do that, we need to focus on developing our magical technologies. Have you seen the Master's Citadel on the Isle of Revelation? I believe it used to belong to another world at some point and appeared here shortly before the Game of the Gods...

If we could create something like this, we wouldn’t have to worry about any darkness ever again.
h: Catherina, what can you tell me about the prophecy?

t: Progress and only progress can save Sarnaut!
